dialogue.content: 今晩は。本日も宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for your time again today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for being here.

dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です
dialogue.English: Good evening, this is the counselor.

dialogue.content: 今晩は。
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: はじめに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか
dialogue.English: First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 55歳男性です。
dialogue.English: I'm a 55-year-old man.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 年上の方に指導したり教育することが多いのですが、きちんと伝わっていないようでどうしたらいいのかわからなくなってしまって・・。
dialogue.English: I often have to guide or train people who are older than me, but it seems like what I'm saying isn't getting through, and I'm at a loss as to what to do...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それは困りますよね、、
dialogue.English: I see, that must be troubling...

dialogue.content: 具体的にどんなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me specifically what has happened?

dialogue.content: はい。困ってしまうし、どうしたら伝わるのか悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: Yes. It leaves me at a loss, and I’m struggling with how to get my message across.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I can understand that...

dialogue.content: 火災報知器の操作方法を教えたりしているのですが、火災報知器がなっても操作がきちんとできない人がいるのです。
dialogue.English: I've been teaching them how to operate the fire alarm system, but there are people who still can't operate it correctly when the alarm goes off.

dialogue.content: せっかく教えたのに、出来ない人がいるのは嫌になりますよね、、
dialogue.English: It must be disheartening when there are people who can't do it, especially after you've taken the time to teach them...

dialogue.content: はい。実際に現場で操作ができずに消防や警察が出動し、教育ができていないと叱られる始末です。
dialogue.English: Yes. In practice, they fail to operate it on site, the fire department and police get dispatched, and I end up being scolded for inadequate training.

dialogue.content: えーっ！こちらのせいになってしまうなんてたまりませんよね、、
dialogue.English: Oh my! It must be unbearable to have it turned around on you like that...

dialogue.content: はい。何回も定期的に教えているのにどうしてなのか・・・
dialogue.English: Yes. Even though I teach them repeatedly and on a regular basis, I don't understand why this keeps happening...

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I can only imagine...

dialogue.content: 手順書なども写真入りで詳しく作っておいてあるのに利用もしてくれません。
dialogue.English: I've even prepared a detailed procedural manual with photos, but they don't even use it.

dialogue.content: せっかく一生懸命作っているのに、がっかりしてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: That must be so disappointing, especially after you worked so hard to create it...

dialogue.content: はい。なんだか私が嫌われて意地悪されているのかと考えてしまいます。
dialogue.English: Yes. It makes me wonder if they dislike me and are being difficult on purpose.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じておられるのですね、、
dialogue.English: I see that's how you've been feeling...

dialogue.content: はい。自分の教え方が悪いのか検証もしているのですが、どうすればもっと、わかりやすくできるのか、ずーっと考えています。
dialogue.English: Yes. I've been reviewing whether my teaching methods are poor, and I'm constantly thinking about how I can make it more understandable.

dialogue.content: うんうん、悩んでしまうのも無理ないですよね・・・
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, it’s only natural to be troubled by this...

dialogue.content: どうしたら上手く伝わるのか・・・。
dialogue.English: How can I get through to them effectively...?

dialogue.content: 何故、これをやらなければいけないか、という事まで教えて時間もかけているのですが。
dialogue.English: I even take the time to explain why this has to be done, and yet...

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・年上の方に教えているということですが、教える対象はいつもだいたい年上の方が多いのでしょうか
dialogue.English: I see... You mentioned you're teaching older people, but are the people you instruct usually older than you?

dialogue.content: すみません、行き違いました
dialogue.English: My apologies, our messages crossed.

dialogue.content: 意図までしっかり考えておらるのですね、、
dialogue.English: So you're even carefully considering the intent behind it...

dialogue.content: でも伝わらない・・悲しいですよね・・
dialogue.English: And yet it doesn’t get through—that’s disheartening, isn't it...

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。様々ですが上の方だと60~73歳までの方がいらっします。
dialogue.English: It's okay. The ages vary, but the older ones range from 60 to 73 years old.

dialogue.content: そうしますと伝わらないのが特に年上の方で、そこにどう伝えたらいいのか？ということでしょうか
dialogue.English: So, the difficulty in getting your message across is particularly with the older individuals, and you’re wondering how best to communicate with them—is that right?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: すべての方がそのような方たちばかりではないのですが・・・。
dialogue.English: It’s not that everyone is like that, though...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: 個人差も考えてカリキュラムを作っています。
dialogue.English: I design the curriculum taking individual differences into account.

dialogue.content: なんと！そこまで考えてやっておられるのですね
dialogue.English: Wow! You’re putting that much thought into it.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 素晴らしいと思います
dialogue.English: I think that’s admirable.

dialogue.content: それなのにできないのは、何故？と思ってしまいます。
dialogue.English: And yet, I can’t help but wonder: why can’t they do it?

dialogue.content: そう思うのは当然だと思います
dialogue.English: I think it’s only natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 同じ現場に8年も務めているのにです。
dialogue.English: And that's even though they’ve been working at the same site for eight years.

dialogue.content: その方がでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you referring to those individuals in particular?

dialogue.content: その現場には3人いるのですが、3人共のようです。
dialogue.English: There are three people at that site, and it seems to be all three of them.

dialogue.content: 消防・警察に呼ばれて1日叱られたとき。
dialogue.English: The time I was called in by the fire department and police and was scolded all day...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: これが初めてではなく、3度目だとのことで非常に双方ともにお怒りでしたが。
dialogue.English: They were both extremely angry, and I was told it wasn’t the first time but the third.

dialogue.content: 私のところに上がった報告は、初めてでした。
dialogue.English: However, it was the first time a report about it had reached me.

dialogue.content: えっ！3度も・・
dialogue.English: What? Three times...?

dialogue.content: どうやら、現場で隠ぺいしていたようです。
dialogue.English: Apparently, they had been covering it up at the site.

dialogue.content: それは驚いてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: That must have been quite a shock...

dialogue.content: 隠ぺい・・・あきれてしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: A cover-up... that's just astounding, isn't it...

dialogue.content: はい。その後、一斉点検で他の現場でも、きちんと操作ができない人がいることが判明して。
dialogue.English: Yes. Afterwards, an inspection of all our sites revealed that there were people at other sites, too, who couldn't operate the system properly.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 再度、つきっきりで指導しましたが、事の重大性に気付いてくれない方もいて。
dialogue.English: I provided one-on-one guidance again, but some of them still didn't seem to realize the gravity of the situation.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: 嫌にもなってきてしまいました。
dialogue.English: I've started to get fed up with it all.

dialogue.content: これだけ真剣になって指導しているのに伝わらない・・
dialogue.English: Even though you're teaching them so seriously, it still doesn’t get through...

dialogue.content: 悲しくなってしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: It's enough to make you feel disheartened...

dialogue.content: 自分が家にいて火災報知機が鳴りっぱなしで避難放送が流れたらどう思うかなども話をしていますが他人ごとのように思っている人もいます。
dialogue.English: I even talk about how they would feel if they were at home and the fire alarm kept ringing with an evacuation announcement, but some people treat it as if it’s someone else’s problem.

dialogue.content: それはとても辛いですよね・・
dialogue.English: That must be very painful...

dialogue.content: 言葉は悪いと思いますが、私は、不良老人と呼んでしまい、会社で叱られました。
dialogue.English: I know this is a bad choice of words, but I ended up calling them 'delinquent seniors,' and I was scolded by the company for it.

dialogue.content: うんうん、そんなふうに呼んでしまうほど腹が立っておられたのですね・・
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, you must have been so frustrated that you ended up calling them that...

dialogue.content: はい。やはり私の教え方に問題があるのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Yes. So, is there really a problem with my teaching methods?

dialogue.content: いえ、そんなことは決して無いと思いますよ
dialogue.English: No, I don't think that's the case at all.

dialogue.content: 問題の3人の方とは、ご自身とは普段はどんな関係性なのでしょうか
dialogue.English: What is your usual relationship with the three individuals in question?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本当にそうなのでしょうか。会社からももう一度、教え方を検討しろと・・・。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Is that really true? The company has also told me to review my teaching methods again...

dialogue.content: 自分ばかり責められて、とても苦しいですよね・・
dialogue.English: It must be very painful to be the only one getting blamed...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 問題の3人とは上司と部下の関係になります。
dialogue.English: With the three in question, it's a supervisor-subordinate relationship.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し具体的に教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you explain in a little more detail?

dialogue.content: はい。私は、営業所の所長の傍ら、教育の責任者もかねています。問題の3人は、現場の警備員です。
dialogue.English: Yes. In addition to being the branch manager, I’m also the head of training. The three in question are on-site security guards.

dialogue.content: 今回の件で、話をしに行った際に、火災報知機を操作するのは、警備員の仕事なのかと言われ・・・。
dialogue.English: When I went to speak with them about this incident, they asked if operating the fire alarm was even part of a security guard’s job...

dialogue.content: えっ！現場の警備員が・・隠ぺいしたりそんなことを・・
dialogue.English: What? The on-site security guards... covering things up and saying things like that...?

dialogue.content: ええ、聴いています
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m listening.

dialogue.content: 警備員の仕事だから教えていると説明しました。
dialogue.English: I explained that it's part of a security guard's job, and that's why I'm teaching it.

dialogue.content: テレビで見ていると制服着て座っているだけでいいと思っていたなどと言い出し・・・。
dialogue.English: They started saying things like from what they see on TV, they thought the job was just about sitting around in a uniform...

dialogue.content: なんと・・
dialogue.English: Oh, my...

dialogue.content: どうやら、私の話を最初から真剣には聴いていないようでした。
dialogue.English: Apparently, they weren't taking what I had to say seriously from the very beginning.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・・それは嫌になってしまいすよね・・
dialogue.English: I see... That would certainly make you feel fed up...

dialogue.content: こんな人たちをちゃんと教育する自信もなくなってしまい。会社に行くのも嫌になってきてしまい。
dialogue.English: I've lost confidence in my ability to properly train people like this, and I'm starting to dread going to work.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 最近は、冬眠する生物がうらやましく思えてくる始末です。
dialogue.English: Lately, I've gotten to the point where I find myself envying animals that hibernate.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに感じておられるのですね・・・そうなるのも当然ですよね
dialogue.English: That's how you're feeling... It's only natural that you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: はい。今までやってきたことが全て無駄だったのかと。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm starting to wonder if everything I’ve done up to now has been for nothing.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: ガッカリです。
dialogue.English: I'm so disappointed.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・・
dialogue.English: I can understand that...

dialogue.content: 不良老人は、更生するのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Can “delinquent seniors” be rehabilitated?

dialogue.content: 大切なことですから、一緒に考えていきましょう
dialogue.English: This is an important matter, so let’s think it through together.

dialogue.content: 辞めさせたいと思うのですが、人事部はなかなか受け入れてくれません。
dialogue.English: I want to have them dismissed, but the HR department is reluctant to agree.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I would appreciate your help.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、もう辞めさせようかとそこまで考えておられるのですね・・
dialogue.English: I see... so you're thinking of going as far as letting them go...

dialogue.content: はい。このままでは、消防・警察、お客様までも信頼を無くしてしまいそうで怖いです。
dialogue.English: Yes. As things stand, I’m afraid we’ll lose the trust of the fire department, the police, and even our clients.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、会社の信頼に関わることですから放ってはおけないですよね・・
dialogue.English: That's right. It concerns the company's reputation, so it can't be ignored...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 火災報知器の件以外では、その3人とはどんな感じで関わっておられますか
dialogue.English: Aside from the fire alarm issue, what is your usual interaction with those three like?

dialogue.content: それまでは、ベテランの警備員として扱っていました。きちんと仕事のできる人たちだと思っていましたので・・・。
dialogue.English: Until then, I had treated them as veteran security guards. I thought they were people who did their jobs properly...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、信頼しておられたのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you trusted them.

dialogue.content: 法定で定められた研修の最後にテストをするのですが、80点くらいの点数は取れていたので。
dialogue.English: At the end of the legally mandated training, we administer a test, and they were scoring around 80 points.

dialogue.content: これで大丈夫だ！と思ってしまいますよね
dialogue.English: That would make you think, “They should be fine!” right?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 火災報知器で件で、特に3人の年配の警備員に伝わらないお話や
dialogue.English: So, regarding the fire alarm issue, there's the fact that you can't get through to the three older security guards,

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それを発端に他の部署にも使えない人がいて、親身になって教えるがどうも伝わらない
dialogue.English: and how that incident led you to find people in other departments who are struggling, and how even when you teach them with great care, the message doesn't get through,

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 消防や警察が出動する騒ぎになった時には、自分が責任者として責められる
dialogue.English: and that when it escalates to the point where the fire department or police are dispatched, you, as the one in charge, are blamed.

dialogue.content: 本当にどうしたらいいのか分からない、辛いお気持が伝わってきました
dialogue.English: I can really feel your painful distress and confusion about not knowing what to do.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 特にこの3人との関係で悩まれていると受け止めましたがいかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: I get the sense that you’re particularly troubled by your relationship with these three—is that correct?

dialogue.content: はい。改心していなさそうなので。
dialogue.English: Yes, because they don’t seem to have had a change of heart.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自身は責任ある立場として、会社のことをとても考えて行動しておられる素晴らしい指導者だと感じました
dialogue.English: I feel that you are a wonderful leader who, in your position of responsibility, acts with great consideration for the company.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 一方で、伝えようとするが自分事として考えない部下、特に警備の3人にとても悩んでおられます
dialogue.English: On the other hand, you are very troubled by your subordinates, especially the three security guards, who don't treat this as their own problem even when you try to communicate it to them.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私が感じましたのは
dialogue.English: What I'm sensing is

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ご自身は、火災報知器の使い方や説明については、本当に分かりやすく伝えておられると思います
dialogue.English: that I believe you are truly explaining how to use the fire alarm in a very clear, easy-to-understand way.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ですから、その3人はやはりことの重大さに気づいておらず、これは個人の考え方を超えたもので、会社として対処すべきことだと思います
dialogue.English: Therefore, I believe those three simply haven't recognized the gravity of the situation, and that this goes beyond individual attitudes—it’s something the company needs to address as a whole.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: さらに厳しい姿勢で対処していくことを検討されてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Have you considered taking a stricter approach in dealing with them?

dialogue.content: そうですね。人事部へは、もう一度、掛け合ってみます。
dialogue.English: You're right. I'll try to negotiate with the HR department one more time.

dialogue.content: このようなことが繰り返されれば、処分を受けるよというようなことを伝えるとか
dialogue.English: For example, you could tell them that if this happens again, there will be disciplinary action.

dialogue.content: はい。そうしてみます。
dialogue.English: Yes, I’ll try that.

dialogue.content: そうですね、毅然と対処すべきことだと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I believe it's something that requires a firm response.

dialogue.content: はい。そうします。
dialogue.English: Yes, I will.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: あなたの職場がさらに良い職場になって
dialogue.English: I hope your workplace becomes an even better place,

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: すみません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry.

dialogue.content: いくことを心から応援しております！
dialogue.English: and I'll be rooting for you with all my heart!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （いえ、こちらこそすみません）
dialogue.English: (No, I'm the one who should be sorry.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした、有難うございました！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your hard work. Thank you very much!)

dialogue.content: （すみませんでした。最後にちぐはぐにしてしまいました。）
dialogue.English: (I’m sorry. I made the ending a bit awkward.)

dialogue.content: 終了してください。
dialogue.English: Please end the session.

dialogue.content: （いえいえ、大変勉強になりました！）
dialogue.English: (Not at all, this was a great learning experience for me!)

dialogue.content: こちらこそです。
dialogue.English: Likewise for me.

dialogue.content: （はい、これで終了させていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Okay, I will conclude the session here.)

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: また、宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.English: I look forward to our next session.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、またよろしくお願いいたします！
dialogue.English: Likewise, I look forward to it too!
